card.name: Places where nitrogen is about to appear
card.fires_on: Words and symbols just before the word nitrogen or a nitrogen-equivalent figure, such as a bracket after protein or the start of nitrogen itself. Also numbers inside protein/nitrogen requirement tables.

modes.label: Before nitrogen mention
modes.description: A bracket, percent sign or the first letters of nitrogen where nitrogen or crude protein is expected next.
modes.example: pulse haulms are high quality roughage (5–8<< percent>> crude protein)

modes.label: Protein and nitrogen dose tables
modes.description: Digits and decimal points inside paired protein and nitrogen values in amino acid dosing tables.

modes.label: Nitrogen balance
modes.description: The word nitrogen itself in a phrase about balance.
modes.example: negative<< nitrogen>> balance with delayed bone and wound healing,
